nodes.Name: Priority
nodes.DocComment:
The Priority is a combination of the syslog facility and
severity. For example, [LOG_ALERT] | [LOG_FTP] sends an alert severity
message from the FTP facility. The default severity is [LOG_EMERG];
the default facility is [LOG_KERN].

nodes.Name: Writer
nodes.DocComment: A Writer is a connection to a syslog server.

nodes.Name: serverConn
nodes.DocComment:
This interface and the separate syslog_unix.go file exist for
Solaris support as implemented by gccgo. On Solaris you cannot
simply open a TCP connection to the syslog daemon. The gccgo
sources have a syslog_solaris.go file that implements unixSyslog to
return a type that satisfies this interface and simply calls the C
library syslog function.

nodes.Name: New
nodes.DocComment:
New establishes a new connection to the system log daemon. Each
write to the returned writer sends a log message with the given
priority (a combination of the syslog facility and severity) and
prefix tag. If tag is empty, the [os.Args][0] is used.

nodes.Name: Dial
nodes.DocComment:
Dial establishes a connection to a log daemon by connecting to
address raddr on the specified network. Each write to the returned
writer sends a log message with the facility and severity
(from priority) and tag. If tag is empty, the [os.Args][0] is used.
If network is empty, Dial will connect to the local syslog server.
Otherwise, see the documentation for net.Dial for valid values
of network and raddr.

nodes.Name: connect
nodes.DocComment:
connect makes a connection to the syslog server.
It must be called with w.mu held.

nodes.Name: Write
nodes.DocComment: Write sends a log message to the syslog daemon.

nodes.Name: Close
nodes.DocComment: Close closes a connection to the syslog daemon.

nodes.Name: Emerg
nodes.DocComment:
Emerg logs a message with severity [LOG_EMERG], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: Alert
nodes.DocComment:
Alert logs a message with severity [LOG_ALERT], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: Crit
nodes.DocComment:
Crit logs a message with severity [LOG_CRIT], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: Err
nodes.DocComment:
Err logs a message with severity [LOG_ERR], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: Warning
nodes.DocComment:
Warning logs a message with severity [LOG_WARNING], ignoring the
severity passed to New.

nodes.Name: Notice
nodes.DocComment:
Notice logs a message with severity [LOG_NOTICE], ignoring the
severity passed to New.

nodes.Name: Info
nodes.DocComment:
Info logs a message with severity [LOG_INFO], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: Debug
nodes.DocComment:
Debug logs a message with severity [LOG_DEBUG], ignoring the severity
passed to New.

nodes.Name: write
nodes.DocComment:
write generates and writes a syslog formatted string. The
format is as follows: <PRI>TIMESTAMP HOSTNAME TAG[PID]: MSG

nodes.Name: NewLogger
nodes.DocComment:
NewLogger creates a [log.Logger] whose output is written to the
system log service with the specified priority, a combination of
the syslog facility and severity. The logFlag argument is the flag
set passed through to [log.New] to create the Logger.
